question:
Using BODMAS, simplify the following.

(7)/(9) × (21)/(5) × 25 (65² – 55²)
solution:
**Given:**

**(7)/(9)** × (21)/(5) × 25 (652 – 552)

 

**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/vUaBr3tL60KzuuO9oMfKO-Skgye0zl5jfd3laYfkuLhd_NG7bYa31x4-8pN3NqN2IMinwHRNuwUbQpLmm6FL2-yvs19LnIBzeVWcitqzx2GUb9ZMv8Tj5GzuRR_4uKTlmCvfRTlV3TKHzuTV] 

**Calculations:**

(7/9) × (21/5) × 25[(652 – 552)]

⇒ (7/9) × (21/5) × 25[(4225 – 3025)]

⇒ (7/9) × (21/5) × 25[1200]

⇒ (7/9) × (21/5) × 30000

⇒ (147/45) × 30000

⇒ 3.266 × 30000 = 98000

**∴ The simplified value of the given equation is 98000.**
